name: CSTAR ablation robot
full_name: CSTAR robotics-assisted ablation-catheter manipulation system (pull-wire drive with tension sensing and model-based contact-force estimation)
group: Western University / CSTAR (R. V. Patel; M. Khoshnam, I. Khalaji)
versions: 2014 BioRob robotics-assisted catheter manipulation for ablation efficiency (title); 2015 IROS system with real-time force estimation (full); 3-DOF manipulator named as ongoing work (IROS 2015 Sec. V)
devices_driven: one 7 Fr unidirectional steerable ablation catheter (Biosense Webster); handle cover removed, prismatic knob fixed to the stage slider (IROS 2015 Sec. II)
n_dof_detail: 1 actuated (pull-wire flexion); catheter body free in the sheath
translation_detail: other: body insertion not actuated; pull-wire driven by a Zaber T-LSR300B motorised linear stage
force_sensing: ATI Nano43 measures pull-wire tension; tip-tissue force estimated from tension plus tip pose (no tip sensor); ATI Nano17 under the tissue as ground truth (IROS 2015 Sec. II)
haptics_leader: none; GUI displays real-time contact-force estimate
imaging_compat: camera tracking of tip markers (640 x 480 px, 30 fps) as fluoroscopy stand-in
validation_detail: artificial tissue on a Nano17 sensor moved by a Zaber T-LSM050A stage, including 8.5 mm sinusoidal wall motion; three cases in Table II (IROS 2015 Sec. IV)
key_numbers: tip placed within +-1 mm of target; contact-force estimation error below 3 gf, maximum 2.64 gf (IROS 2015 abstract, Sec. V)
